GASColorTransformObject::GetMember. Named. Eight named channel reads plus `rgb`, which packs the three OFFSETS as 0xRRGGBB after truncating each to a byte. Ported

GASColorTransformProto::Concat. Named. offset' = offset * second.multiplier + second.offset, multiplier' = multiplier * second.multiplier. Ported as ColorTransformConcat

GASColorTransformProto::ToString. Named. Deliberate omission, stated as a deviation: nothing in this cook calls toString on a ColorTransform, and installing it would add a printf-family formatter to a file that has none
GASColorTransformProto constructor. Named. Retail's prototype carries concat and toString; this tree installs concat only (see 0xa77430)

GASTransformCtorFunction::GlobalCtor. Named. Requires one argument, resolves it with GASEnvironment::FindTargetByValue, leaves the result undefined when it names no clip, and guards the reuse path on GetObjectType()==20 - which pins Object_Transform = 20. Ported as TransformCtor
GASTransformCtorFunction::CreateNewObject. Named. Ported as TransformNewObject

GASTransformObject constructor. Named. Ported
GASTransformObject::GetMember. Named. colorTransform answers a fresh ColorTransform built from the character's Cxform; matrix answers a Matrix built from its GMatrix2D. Ported

GASTransformObject::SetMember. Named. Ported
